## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (Energy, Healthcare, Financials positive) alongside mixed Tech leadership (AAPL/MSFT ABOVE TREND vs NVDA/GOOGL BELOW TREND) and Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); style: Value/Cyclical tilt but mixed overall.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +10.09%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +10.04%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing strength: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +6.63%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -5.67%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND. Materials and Utilities weak on the week; Industrials mixed with BA (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -8.05%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND; ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND; MMM (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND; BMY (1W: +6.99% | 1M: +14.11%) ABOVE TREND; PM (1W: +6.87% | 1M: +6.28%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical/defensive mix.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LRCX (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -17.23%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -13.94%) BELOW TREND; DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) TREND EXHAUSTION; NFLX (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -11.26%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -8.52%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND; ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND; MMM (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present: multiple large caps with 1W ≠ 1M (META, V, JNJ, DHR) — MAJOR Divergence, watch for trend break and tactical setups.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak; Tech on net down this week (Technology 1W: -1.13%). AAPL (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND and MSFT (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND contrast with NVDA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND and AMAT (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -8.52%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation, monitor earnings/cycle cues.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive; Financials positive on the week (Financials 1W: +0.66%). PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +6.63%) ABOVE TREND provide leadership, though GS (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -1.00%) BELOW TREND and MS (1W: -4.95% | 1M: -3.03%) BELOW TREND keep breadth mixed.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthy and acting defensively/cyclically; ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND, but ISRG (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -13.94%) BELOW TREND and DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) TREND EXHAUSTION warrant selective exposure.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Energy exposure and select Healthcare names given breadth; reduce exposure to weak/high-volatility Tech names (NVDA, LRCX, AMAT) showing BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt but mixed market signals — keep position sizing disciplined given MAJOR Divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND — takeover headlines confirmed by price; MPC (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +31.64%) ABOVE TREND — energy momentum; MMM (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND — strong beat-and-raise. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND — watch for follow-through, LRCX (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -17.23%) BELOW TREND, DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) TREND EXHAUSTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.27%) Sector Strength; Healthcare (1W: +1.81%) Internal strength. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.13%) Sector Weakness; Materials (1W: -0.92%) at risk of further underperformance.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor NVDA for sustained BELOW TREND continuation or short-term recovery; watch PYPL post-news momentum for follow-through above this week’s move; watch DHR and META for confirmation/extension of TREND EXHAUSTION signals; monitor sector rotation flows into Energy/Financials for allocation shifts.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MMM (+90): 3M (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming after beat-and-raise. PYPL (+80): PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed, takeover chatter fueling momentum. ABBV (+55): ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND — EU approval news aligning with strong price action. WBD (+80): WBD (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price diverging (distribution risk).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
DHR (-55): DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) TREND EXHAUSTION — bearish news and sharp 1W drop, confirmation of downside risk. (Other top negative-sentiment names flagged in feeds include MRK and ADBE but price/timeframe data not in the current detailed view.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Value/Cyclical tilt. PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +10.09%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR Divergence across large caps (NVDA/GOOGL BELOW TREND vs AAPL/MSFT ABOVE TREND) and several TREND EXHAUSTION names (DHR, META) — monitor sentiment-price divergences (e.g., WBD) for confirmation.
